summary: Feature: Real-Time Analysis Progress via WebSockets

details.user_story: As a User, I want to see a real-time progress bar during analysis so that I know exactly how much of my video has been processed.
details.context: Current HTTP implementation is a 'black box' until completion. We need a persistent connection to stream frame-by-frame progress from the AI Engine to the Mobile UI.
acceptance_criteria: Backend: Implement a WebSocket endpoint `/ws/analysis/{job_id}` using FastAPI.
AI Service: Update the processing loop to emit a 'progress_update' event after every 5-10 frames.
Mobile: Replace the static spinner with a percentage-based progress bar (0-100%).
Reliability: Handle WebSocket disconnection/reconnection if the signal drops mid-swing.
Cleanup: Ensure WebSocket connections are closed once the final JSON result is delivered.
technical_details: Backend: FastAPI `WebsocketManager` to track active client connections.
Frontend: React Native `WebSocket` API integrated into the Analysis screen.
